name: Box truck
definition: rigid truck with an enclosed windowless cargo box fitted behind the cab.

name: Dump truck (tipper)
definition: rigid truck whose open body tips on hydraulic rams to unload loose material.

name: Flatbed or dropside truck
definition: rigid truck with a flat open load deck, with or without fold-down side gates.

name: Motocross bike
definition: off-road competition motorcycle made for closed motocross and supercross tracks.

name: Enduro bike
definition: off-road motorcycle made for long timed cross-country enduro events, often with lights for road links.

name: Trials bike
definition: light seatless off-road motorcycle made for slow obstacle-crossing trials riding.
